articles.title: Crypto IPO market stalls as capital rotates to AI and macro uncertainty weighs
articles.snippet: Funding constraints and investor caution, not regulation, are delaying crypto IPOs, according to Cohen & Company Capital Markets' Christian Lopez.

articles.title: Hyundai becomes first major South Korean company to introduce internal stablecoin transfers
articles.snippet: The initiative builds on a broader shift by companies exploring stablecoins to move money between international operations more efficiently.

articles.title: Senate Democrats call for hearings into Trump’s ties to crypto amid CLARITY Act discussions
articles.snippet: Five senators called for committee hearings to investigate US President Donald Trump’s policies potentially being influenced by crypto funding from United Arab Emirates-linked and other entities.

articles.title: USDC issuer Circle wins final approval for US national trust bank charter
articles.snippet: Circle announces it received final OCC approval for a national trust bank that will initially serve the company and affiliates, with possible future custody services for institutional clients.

articles.title: Apple Sues OpenAI, Claims Former Employees Stole Trade Secrets
articles.snippet: Apple alleges former employees took confidential designs, supplier information, and engineering files before joining OpenAI.
